hero.name: Ali Mansouri
hero.title: Solutions Architect
hero.manifesto: I diagnose messy enterprise operations, map the system dynamics, frame the architecture, and ship the digital infrastructure that sustains growth.

aboutMe.title: Summary
aboutMe.text: Driven Solutions Architect with 5+ years of experience delivering end-to-end cloud-native platforms, enterprise AI systems, and LLM automation—from requirements scoping to high-scale resilience and production deployment. I view organizational friction as structural technical debt; my approach is to accurately diagnose the root friction first, then build deep, highly optimized core services where execution matters most. Backed by a PhD candidacy in Futures Studies and an MBA, my technical stack is anchored in Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, Python, n8n, and production AI architectures (RAG, LangChain). At Snapp, I engineered production LLM automations, streamlined core workflow integrations, and governed the enterprise Jira platform architecture.

pillars.title: Strategic Foresight
pillars.text: Doctoral-level mastery in System Dynamics and scenario modeling; architecting long-term organizational future readiness, strategic pathways, and adaptability toward macro-trends.

pillars.title: Cloud-Native Engineering
pillars.text: Production-grade deployment of Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform alongside automated CI/CD pipelines to guarantee system resilience, corporate data governance, and reproducible delivery.

pillars.title: AI & Automation
pillars.text: Designed and deployed production-grade LLM architectures featuring RAG, vector databases, and LangChain, embedding intelligence directly into operational business workflows rather than isolated chat experiments.

positions.title: Solutions Architect (Cloud, Systems & AI)
points: Architected and governed cloud-native infrastructure for core internal services on production Docker and Kubernetes (Helm), driving systemic scalability, high availability, and deployment resilience.

Engineered a multi-module enterprise automation platform and custom IAM infrastructure for end-to-end user authentication and authorization (LDAP/OIDC SSO, granular RBAC, governance dashboards, and module-level permissioning) for 1,000+ internal users; developed core Python/SQL backend services.
Streamlined deployment lifecycles by deploying 10+ production services via automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines (build, test, deploy), eliminating manual intervention risks.
Designed and deployed production-grade LLM automation featuring RAG, vector databases, and LangChain to optimize and accelerate corporate document triage processes.
Managed the end-to-end delivery of digital LMS and HR infrastructure across multiple business units, covering stakeholder discovery, requirements scoping, system architecture, and final rollout.

positions.title: Solutions Architect (Workflow, Systems & Integration)
points: Architected enterprise-level workflow automations using ScriptRunner, Behaviours, and custom auto-fillers, eliminating operational bottlenecks and manual overhead across complex multi-tier approval chains.
Modeled data structures within Jira Assets (Insight), establishing strict governance frameworks and real-time leadership dashboards for cross-functional system health monitoring.
Spearheaded the integration ecosystem architecture bridging Jira, GitLab, Confluence, SQL Server, and Recruitee, deploying n8n as a resilient orchestration engine across 6+ backend APIs.
Scoped platform extensions (helpdesk, process designers, and data connectors) using fit-gap analysis, successfully streamlining support operations and minimizing ad-hoc IT tickets.

positions.title: Solutions Architect (Organizational Systems & P&OD)
points: Diagnosed root causes behind critical repeating operational process failures using data analytics and systemic modeling before defining software specifications.
Digitalized onboarding and administrative workflows into highly reproducible operations, accelerating processing cycles and building the foundational framework for the scaled enterprise platform.

bodyspinner.title: Data & Systems Analyst (Part-time)
points: Architected and deployed analytical dashboards using Power BI for comprehensive system monitoring, successfully automating legacy manual reporting overhead.
Trained and implemented Machine Learning models (CNN, MLflow) to drive algorithmic pricing optimization and data-driven decision-support systems across the platform's SKUs.
Maintained custom ticketing and information tracking systems, applying core Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to ensure maximum platform uptime and stability.
Audited Jira data architecture and system configurations, elevating enterprise data accuracy, integrity, and operational quality.

arsh.title: Digital Transformation Specialist
arsh.companyNote: شهرزاد · Full-time · Product Strategy & Initial Architecture
points: Contributed to the foundational product strategy and initial roadmap design of the Shahrzaad platform, aligning operational requirements with digital product specifications from ideation to final launch.

Systematized core back-office operations by migrating manual paper-based processes into structured digital workflows for recruitment, payroll, and administration across Frontend, Backend, PM, and Finance teams.
Defined job descriptions, OKR, and KPI frameworks to ensure role clarity, manage performance evaluation, and align core team milestones with overall business objectives.
Optimized end-to-end HR pipelines, including talent acquisition, structured onboarding/offboarding, employer branding, and technical assessment design for developer trainee positions.

karencrowd.title: Business Evaluator & Investment Analyst
points: Evaluated startup ventures and early-stage companies through structured due diligence processes and financial valuation frameworks.
Formulated a systematic startup evaluation framework combining forward-looking risk scoring with financial analysis to streamline and accelerate review cycles.
Produced strategic business plans that enhanced funding acquisition success rates and facilitated smoother launch operations.
